newsitem.title: UK: LLOYD'S DETAILS THIRD CAPACITY AUCTION RESULT.
newsitem.headline: LLOYD'S DETAILS THIRD CAPACITY AUCTION RESULT.

text.p: Lloyd's of London on Friday announced the results of the third auction of syndicate capacity for the 1998 underwriting year.
A total of 218 million stg of market capacity involving 106 syndicates underwriting this year was successfully auctioned at a total value of 15 million pounds.
Subscription offers (offers to buy) totalled 681 million stg and tenders (offers to sell) totalled 495 million stg during the auction held 6-7 August.
The auction -- which this year uses a fully electronic system -- is the third in a series of eight auctions being held from July to September.
The fourth auction will be held 20-21 August.
